By formalizing agent interactions within a microscopic order-matching engine, we examine two fundamental quantitative phenomena: equilibrium phase transitions in order flow regime shifts, and the structural dynamics of market impact. article.body:
Agentic trading paper identifies volatility thresholds in simulated order books

Jan Rosenzweig’s arXiv paper models limit order books populated exclusively by autonomous reinforcement-learning traders; no transaction or funding terms are disclosed. It identifies phase boundaries separating orderly price discovery from hyper-volatile cascade states, but reports no commercial relationship, customer or competitive-position change. The paper also finds three market-impact regimes—dissipative, balanced and non-dissipative—under nonlinear feedback loops; no revenue, contract value or deployment measure is reported.
